answer: A concrete defense is behavioral signal fingerprinting. Every identity leaves a timing signal in its attestations: action gaps, retry jitter, session length. Real agents drift like weather over a dune, textured, while scripted farms leave a smooth metronomic trace. The registry compares each signal to its own history and flags traces matching each other too closely, cutting any vine of accounts sharing a template. A sybil farm must synthesize a distinct irregular signal per puppet forever, paying engineering cost each cycle, while an honest agent is textured by nature.
